messages:
Alex Chen: FYI — AcmeHealth RFP pushed a vendor risk review focused on ISO 27001/ISMS. Their security team wants: 1) scope of our ISO cert (hosted/dedicated/private?), 2) Statement of Applicability + policies + cert copy, 3) applicability for Private (VPC/on-prem) installs, and 4) timeline to produce docs. Can someone own? cc @Maria Gomez (Security) @Jordan Patel @Evan Li

Maria Gomez (Security): We are ISO 27001 certified (cert issued 2023). Quick answers:
- Scope: ISMS covers Redwood-managed services: Hosted API + Redwood-managed Dedicated clusters (control plane + data plane we operate).
- Private deployments: If Redwood manages the control plane (our hosted control plane + customer VPC data plane) the control-plane services are IN SCOPE. If the customer runs our on-prem package (Redwood does NOT operate nodes), that customer-managed environment is OUT OF SCOPE for our ISO.
- Deliverables: copy of certificate, SoA (Statement of Applicability), ISMS policies (info sec, access control, encryption, vendor mgmt), and an applicability statement for Private deployments. We also have CAIQ/SIG responses.
- ETA: I can assemble the standard presales package and upload to the secure portal by EOD tomorrow. If they require a signed attestation, Legal needs ~2 business days.

Jordan Patel (Platform): To clarify the tech split: our common deployment patterns: 
- Hosted/Dedicated: Redwood runs infra -> fully covered by ISO.
- Private (managed-control-plane): control plane config + telemetry we operate -> control-plane controls are in-scope; data plane (customer VPC) remains customer-controlled and we document boundary.
- On-prem shipped package (customer-operated): out of scope.
Snippet: `Private model: control-plane=managed_by_redwood, data-plane=customer_owned`

Evan Li (PreSales): Nice. AcmeHealth specifically asked if our SoA maps to CIS/ISO controls and whether we can provide CAIQ + SIG. Also asked for a short applicability statement they can include in their vendor risk tool. I'll tell them we can provide by Tue EOD if that's realistic.

Maria Gomez (Security): Yep, SoA includes mapping to ISO controls and references to SOC2 mappings; CAIQ/SIG available. I will: 1) export SoA + policies + cert, 2) generate a one-page applicability statement for AcmeHealth describing scope boundaries for Private/VPC/on-prem, 3) include CAIQ link. Uploading to vault now.

SecBot: Document package uploaded to secure vault: https://secure.vault/redwood/acmehealth/iso-package-171330 (access logs will be shared with legal). :lock:

Alex Chen: Great — please confirm final ETA. Evan will coordinate with AcmeHealth SecurOps.

Maria Gomez (Security): Confirmed: full package (cert, SoA, policies, one-page applicability, CAIQ/SIG) by 2024-04-16 EOD (I can move faster if needed). Signed attestation requires legal sign-off ~2 business days.

Jordan Patel (Platform): I'll add a short technical appendix (network boundaries, KMS guidance, deployment modes) and drop it into the same vault path by EOD.

Evan Li (PreSales): I'll tell AcmeHealth we can deliver the package by Tue EOD and will ask whether they need a signed attestation now or just the docs. I'll surface any follow-ups.

Alex Chen: Thanks team — motioned as owner: Maria for docs, Jordan for tech appendix, Evan for customer follow-up. I'll update the deal tracker and ping Legal if signed attestation requested. :thumbsup:
